options.name: always_update_password
options.description: If true and O(authentication_password) is set, this module will always report a change and set the password value to O(authentication_password) . If false, other properties are still checked for differences. If a difference is found, the value of O(authentication_password) is still used. If O(authentication_password) is unset, this parameter is ignored. This option is needed because there is no way to check the current password value and compare it against the desired password value.

options.name: authentication_method
options.description: The method of authentication to use if this is a subscribed or published local library. If the library is a local, non-published library, this option has no effect. The only options are NONE for no authentication or BASIC for username and password authentication. The username for BASIC auth cannot be changed, and is vcsp.

options.name: authentication_password
options.description: The password to use when O(authentication_method) is V(BASIC). If BASIC auth is not enabled, this option is ignored.

options.name: datastore
options.description: The name of the datastore that should be a storage backing for the library. This parameter is required when O(state) is V(present) This parameter only takes effect when the library is first created. You cannot change the storage backing for an existing library, and the module will not check this value in that case.

options.name: description
options.description: The description for the content library.

options.name: hostname
options.description: The hostname or IP address of the vSphere vCenter server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(VMWARE_HOST) will be used instead.

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the subscribed content library to manage.

options.name: password
options.description: The password of the vSphere vCenter server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(VMWARE_PASSWORD) will be used instead.

options.name: port
options.description: The port number of the vSphere vCenter server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(VMWARE_PORT) will be used instead.

options.name: proxy_host
options.description: The address of a proxy that will receive all HTTPS requests and relay them. The format is a hostname or a IP. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(VMWARE_PROXY_HOST) will be used instead.

options.name: proxy_port
options.description: The port of the HTTP proxy that will receive all HTTPS requests and relay them. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(VMWARE_PROXY_PORT) will be used instead.

options.name: proxy_protocol
options.description: The proxy connection protocol to use. This option is used if the correct proxy protocol cannot be automatically determined.

options.name: ssl_thumbprint
options.description: If specified, the thumbprint presented by the subscribed URL will be validated against this value.

options.name: state
options.description: Whether the content library should be present or absent.

options.name: subscription_url
options.description: The URL of the remote library to which you want to subscribe. This parameter is required when configuring a subscribed library.

options.name: update_on_demand
options.description: Whether to download all content on demand, or download all content ahead of time.

options.name: username
options.description: The username of the vSphere vCenter server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(VMWARE_USER) will be used instead.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Allows connection when SSL certificates are not valid. Set to V(false) when certificates are not trusted. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(VMWARE_VALIDATE_CERTS) will be used instead.
